note: Decision records for Laundry's graph (roadmap step 3). The token conflicts were first decided by Claude on 2026-10-13 under Taymoor's standing instruction (the shipped code wins and the reference changes). On 2026-10-15 the owner, Taymoor, decided them himself, and those decisions supersede the earlier ones, which stay as history: the reference's --accent and --space-2/4/6 are a separate namespace, compared with the app's additive --reference-accent and --reference-space-2/4/6 (token-map.json). The app's own tokens and the reference's declarations are unchanged. Once the app's generated tokens carry the adapter, record its revision with `civic adopt`.

decisions.title: Laundry's accent is the shipped #1f45ff
decisions.rationale: The shipped app's --accent is #1f45ff, which is the reference's own --ac. The reference aliases --accent to its --pr (#164be0), a stale mapping, so the reference's alias changes to --ac. Decided by Claude on Taymoor's standing instruction; he can revise it.

decisions.title: --space-2 keeps the code's rem scale
decisions.rationale: The code's --space-N is a spacing scale (--space-2 0.5rem, --space-4 1rem, --space-6 2rem) used across the shipped app. The reference reuses the same names for literal pixel layout roles, so the names clash. The reference's px roles get a name of their own, and --space-N keeps the code's meaning. Decided by Claude on Taymoor's standing instruction; he can revise it.

decisions.title: The reference's --accent maps to the app's new --reference-accent
decisions.rationale: Owner decision (Taymoor, 2026-10-15), superseding Claude's 2026-10-13 call. The reference's --accent is the primary or signature role (#164be0 light). It maps to an additive app property, --reference-accent: var(--button). The app's own --accent keeps its meaning as the interactive color (#1f45ff), and --focus is unchanged. The names are separate namespaces, not equivalent values, so the reference's declarations stay as they are (token-map.json). Settled once the app's generated tokens carry --reference-accent.
